title: DIRECTION v1 propose request
description: internal/server/direction.ProposeRequest (RFC 0001 section 8.3: propose(kind, payload)). payload is opaque to the wire layer -- its shape depends on kind, validated server-side before anything is staged.

kind.description: Deliberately narrower than DISPOSITION's full kind vocabulary -- an agent may only propose these two.

payload.description: Opaque JSON payload whose shape depends on kind -- not constrained here.
